summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a four-tranche offering of senior unsecured notes with unspecified principal amounts, coupons, and maturities, offered via joint book-running managers Barclays, HSBC, J.P. Morgan, and NatWest. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt, carry optional make-whole and tax-redemption features, and are expected to list on Nasdaq within 30 days. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, tranche sizes, and spreads versus Treasuries.
